evidence-bench.name: Evidence bench blocking
evidence-bench.text: Keep recovered objects physically localized on a controlled work surface. Characters gather around the evidence without theatrical posing; one person manipulates while others observe or compare data.

analysis-wall.name: Analysis wall blocking
analysis-wall.text: Use the large analysis display as shared working space. Characters should point to specific relationships, traces, or branches rather than stand in a generic command-room lineup.
